scenes.desc: Opens on notifications piling up (Outlook, Gmail, SMS, WhatsApp, LSE, MyClass, UoL): it is overwhelming. Freeze at 8.0, implode 9.1-10.
DROP. DSBA Hub: 'Here to help you through it.' + subline + 5 pills.
Feature 1 - the newsletter in a 3D browser frame: CFA Research Challenge, Student Council, Speech Day, the launch.
Feature 2 - Forum: the list (with Arabic threads); 'What is this, am I cooked?' is typed and posted in Year 1 Mathematical Methods; Nasser replies; easter egg.
Montage: library, lessons, Career Navigator (scrolls), calendar, grades, search; cohorts network; 'Built by students.'
'Launching today' + LAUNCH button + 3/2/1 countdown + click at 63.85.
Glitch #1: freeze, corruption, error windows, static, black.
4.4 s of darkness: a collar bell, two eyes, blinks. Lights on: Noor's cat in a party hat, 'Happy Birthday, Noor'.
Glitch #2: song cut on the final 'you', scramble, terminal (expected Noor's birthday, found Teacher's Day), flash, black+silence.
Letter to the teachers, typed line by line over soft piano; riser into the drop.
DROP: HAPPY TEACHER'S DAY, gold, particles; 'Yes, it was yesterday.'
'We study data. So we ran the numbers on you.' Four statistics jokes, one card each (4 s; the last one 6 s).
The three cohorts as one network; the ~160 dots gather into THANK YOU.
Happy Teacher's Day sign-off, institution logos, the cat says Meow, fade to black.
